name: yantra
description: Local Electron app for a canvas-based LLM workspace

scripts.start: pnpm build:electron:dev && sh -c 'vite --host 127.0.0.1 & VITE_PID=$!; YANTRA_DEV_SERVER=1 electron .; kill $VITE_PID'
scripts.test:deletion-perf: pnpm build:electron && esbuild tools/vault-deletion-perf.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/vault-deletion-perf.cjs --external:electron --external:esbuild && electron dist-electron/vault-deletion-perf.cjs
scripts.test:creation-perf: pnpm build:electron && esbuild tools/vault-creation-perf.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/vault-creation-perf.cjs --external:electron --external:esbuild && electron dist-electron/vault-creation-perf.cjs
scripts.test:reorder-perf: pnpm build:electron && esbuild tools/vault-reorder-perf.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/vault-reorder-perf.cjs --external:electron --external:esbuild && electron dist-electron/vault-reorder-perf.cjs --assert
scripts.test:vault-ui: pnpm build && esbuild tools/vault-ui-smoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/vault-ui-smoke.cjs --external:electron && electron dist-electron/vault-ui-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:vault-refactor: esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/refactor-preload.cjs --external:electron --define:__VAULT_DIAGNOSTICS__=true && esbuild tools/vault-refactor-smoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/vault-refactor-smoke.cjs --external:electron --external:vite --define:__VAULT_DIAGNOSTICS__=true && electron dist-electron/vault-refactor-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:math-ui: pnpm build && esbuild tools/math-ui-smoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/math-ui-smoke.cjs --external:electron --define:__VAULT_DIAGNOSTICS__=false && electron dist-electron/math-ui-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:workspace-ui: pnpm build && esbuild tools/workspace-ui-smoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/workspace-ui-smoke.cjs --external:electron --define:__VAULT_DIAGNOSTICS__=false && electron dist-electron/workspace-ui-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:tabs-ui: pnpm build:electron && vite build --mode ui-regressions && esbuild tools/tabs-ui-smoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/tabs-ui-smoke.cjs --external:electron && electron dist-electron/tabs-ui-smoke.cjs
scripts.check:ui-regressions: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm exec vitest run src/renderer/stores/vaultWorkspace.test.ts src/renderer/stores/workspace-tabs.test.ts src/renderer/vault/tab-drag-model.test.ts src/renderer/vault/sidebar-selection.test.ts src/renderer/vault/document-editor-sync.test.ts src/shared/vault-organization.test.ts src/shared/vault-batch-move.test.ts src/main/vault-organization.test.ts src/main/vault-canvas-workspace.test.ts && pnpm test:tabs-ui
